comment_regular: Oblivion generic authored-key range copier. For non-type-4 tracks, counts existing timestamps inclusively in [start,end], allocates through content/type dispatch, type-copies each selected record, and rebases its timestamp to time-start. Does not synthesize boundary samples. For rotation type 4, recursively slices three scalar axes, allocates one 0x4C outer Euler record, and installs the axis results.
